items.title: 56422_Leonard Phillips oral history interview
items.q: In 1936, joined Count Basie at the Reno Club, Kansas City. Left Kansas City with Basie, and made recording debut in October 1936.

ctx.x: "...in Minneapolis, then moved back to Kansas City, gigged in various clubs, including the Sunset and the Subway. During 1936 unsuccessfully auditioned for Earl Hines' Big Band. In 1936, joined Count Basie at the Reno Club, Kansas City. Left Kansas City with Basie, and made recording debut in October 1936." So we'll stop there, and then you can pick up where you left off about him joining the band, the King Oliver group.

Well, he joined us, and then he went to... A lot of what they're saying there is wrong. He didn't go back to Minneapolis no more after he left... I mean, to work... He might have went there to play with Basie or somebody. But when he left Minneapolis with the Blue Devils Band, Kansas City, that's where he was. When the band broke
